through_line: Afterword: the record's horizon (the 2019 letter; 2021 in a clause each; Vivek's post of 20 February 2022 the latest dated item; the survey 2021 or later, RR-31); protection building by building and no one answering for the town; the proposals on record from translations on site, guides and walks, clearing and monitoring, schools, residents and merchants, readers of inscriptions and the book's open questions, to circuits, partnership and Mishra's heritage town, each attributed; the proposals tested 'on the evidence of this book' (who pays, where the risk is, pace, people); the one argument, 'this book argues', conservation by use; the close on the temple seen from the Ganj Basoda road and the lane its residents widened.
